entities.summary: Hisashi Tonomura , better known by his stage name HISASHI, is a Japanese musician best known as the lead guitarist of the rock band Glay. He is particularly associated with the brand Tokai, designing a series of personal signature guitars, based on their Talbo model. Hisashi was a composers & musicians from Hirosaki (b. 1972-02-02, Hirosaki). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
